exposure: Expectant management (labor after cesarean section (LAC) at ≥40 weeks)
cohort: Women undergoing labor after cesarean section (LAC) with no prior vaginal delivery
finding: Induction of labor at 39 weeks in women undergoing LAC with no prior vaginal delivery was not associated with improved neonatal outcomes compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Induction of labor (IOL) at 39 weeks in women undergoing labor after cesarean section (LAC) with no prior vaginal delivery was not associated with improved neonatal outcomes compared to expectant management.
